{{Quote|The classic! A grilled-to-perfection patty topped with all the fixin's--a slice of Gonzo yellow cheese, Revwien lettuce, topato slices, grilled Ojomian onions and B'omarr-style pickles.|Dex's Diner menu, on the Coruscant slider|<ref name="Menu" />}}
The '''Coruscant slider''' was one of the basic [[slider]]s served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] owned and operated by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] was served on a trans-shipped [[medium-density food-board]] with a [[Limb/Legends|hand]]&ndash;formed [[Mongo Beefhead patty]], a slice of [[Gonzo yellow cheese]], [[Revwien lettuce]], [[Topato/Legends|topato]] slices, grilled [[Ojomian onion]]s, and [[B'omarr-style pickle]]s. Like all sliders served at his diner, the Coruscant slider came with Jettster's special [[slider garnish]]. The meal cost 6.5 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]], and for an additional charge of 10 decicreds a customer add an additional meat patty to the slider. It could also be bought alongside another basic slider as a [[Talus and Tralus slider]] meal. A customer could request both [[Sernpidalian mayo-ketchup]] and [[Bimm mustard]] to go with the meal at no charge.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Coruscant sliders were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
